name: Is it better to install a walk-in shower or a tub-shower combo in an addition?

mainEntity.name: Is it better to install a walk-in shower or a tub-shower combo in an addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: A walk-in shower is ideal for smaller footprints, master suites, and homeowners seeking modern design or accessible, low-step entry. However, shower installations require specialized waterproofing membranes, sloped mortar pans, and custom wall tiling. A tub-shower combination works better if your home currently lacks a bathtub, which is an important consideration for households with young children or pets. Tubs can also simplify installation if using a prefabricated alcove unit, though tiled surrounds still demand careful moisture barriers, drywall tape, and precise finish carpentry around trim and fixtures.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a walk-in shower for modern accessibility and smaller footprints, or a tub-shower combo if your home lacks an existing bathtub for family utility.
